questions.text: This project already has an approved requirement, REQ-marketing-process-node-management, that documents nodes with a full data model (id/name/description, input/output, Level 1 (what) vs Level 2 (how) docs, automation status/trigger/conditions/actions, tool/URL references) and next_nodes chaining. Decision dec-go-5 approves a separate change request (feat-process-node-management-1) whose description is narrower: "Create, edit, remove, and independently document nodes that represent individual marketing activities." Is REQ-process-node-management meant to (a) supersede/replace the existing requirement's data model, (b) reuse it as-is under a new requirement id, or (c) define a distinct, simpler node concept that coexists with it? Please clarify the relationship.

The feature description for this requirement only mentions create/edit/remove/document for individual nodes - it does not mention connecting nodes into a sequence (next_nodes / process flow). Should this requirement include node-to-node linking/ordering, or is sequencing explicitly out of scope here (e.g. handled by a separate future requirement)?
questions.answer: handled by a separate future requirement

questions.text: "Independently document" a node - does this mean the same Level 1 (what)/Level 2 (how) split used in REQ-marketing-process-node-management, or a different/simpler set of fields (e.g. just name, description, notes)? Please specify the fields a node should carry.

Project prj-maternity-7 currently has no Applications defined (GET /api/projects/prj-maternity-7/apps returns an empty list), but a Work Item for REQ-process-node-management requires an applicationId. Which Application should this work item be created under - an existing one that needs to be added first, or a new Application that should be created for this work (e.g. a marketing-process-management service/app, distinct from the maternal-care platform apps described in the project blueprint)? Please specify the application (name/id) to use.
